paper_metadata.title: Laser powder bed fusion of an age-hardenable Mg-10Gd-0.2Zr alloy with excellent strength-ductility synergy

evidence.quote: Herein a Mg-10Gd-0.2Zr (wt%) alloy was reported to achieve excellent strength-ductility synergy with the product of ultimate tensile strength and elongation of 2791.3 MPa × % just by laser powder bed fusion (LPBF).
